location.site_context: FM 2720 at Bob White Road / Prime Data Centers LLC Reinvestment Zone #1; Prime's public Austin AUS01 materials list 3300 FM 2720 for the campus.

status_as_of_cutoff: approved-permitted / development: Caldwell County designated Prime Data Centers LLC Reinvestment Zone #1 on 2024-03-12 and approved a Lockhart Property, LLC development agreement for 205.756 acres on 2026-04-23; TDLR registered Prime Data Center AUS-01 on 2026-05-05 for two 380,000-square-foot shell buildings at 1395 Bob White Road. Prime's current Austin AUS01 materials describe a 205-acre, eight-facility, 384 MW critical IT load campus in development. No official construction-start inspection, building permit, certificate of occupancy, utility energization, or live-service record was located as of 2026-08-11.
evidence_grade: A-: official Caldwell County reinvestment-zone/development-agreement actions and official TDLR registration establish local process and state registration; campus MW is from owner/developer materials; physical construction and energization remain unverified.

contradictions.details: TDLR lists two shell buildings at 1395 Bob White Road totaling 760,000 square feet, while Prime's AUS01 campus materials list 3300 FM 2720, eight facilities, 2,000,000 square feet, and 384 MW critical IT load. These appear to describe building-level versus campus-level records for the same Caldwell/Lockhart project area rather than a verified contradiction, but the exact mapping of TDLR AUS01/AUS02 to Prime's eight-facility campus remains unconfirmed.

A Caldwell County highlights page says Prime Data Centers is constructing a turn-key campus, but the official minutes and TDLR record reviewed here do not provide inspection, building-permit, CO, utility energization, or live-service evidence. Structured status therefore remains approved-permitted / development rather than site work-construction.
